name: Unbiased Depth Rendering (PGSR)
definition: A method to approximate true surfaces and estimate normal maps by flattening 3D Gaussian ellipsoids into planes via minimizing aligned scale factors, then rendering depth and normals via alpha-blending.
summary: Unbiased Depth Rendering (PGSR) estimates precise depth maps by flattening 3D Gaussian ellipsoids into planes and calculating ray-plane intersections, distinguishing itself from weighted average methods.
